description: Battery temperature, Omnibattery's charge derate and the thermal shadow model: measured against predicted, forecast error per lead, achievable charge power and the model's fit (KPIs of docs/components/battery-thermal.md; the thermal metrics start with service 0.10.0).

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Battery internal temperature (fresh reading, sensor.venus_internal_temperature).

panels.title: Charge derate factor
panels.description: Factor of Omnibattery's curve at the measured temperature: 1 = no derate, lower = the charge power is cut.

panels.title: Temperature charge limit
panels.description: State of Omnibattery's Temperature Charge Limit switch (read only): off, on or unknown.

panels.title: Model status
panels.description: prior: the documented parameters, no accepted refit yet. fitted: parameters from an accepted refit. degraded: a fitted model that no longer passes its checks.

panels.title: Last accepted fit
panels.description: Time since the accepted refit that produced the parameters. No value while the model is on the prior: the service exports no timestamp until a refit is accepted.

panels.title: Buffer
panels.description: Hours with a temperature reading in the one-minute observation buffer the refit uses.

panels.title: Battery temperature: measured and predicted (degC)
panels.description: Measured: thermal_temperature_celsius. Predicted: thermal_predicted_temperature_celsius, the newest plan's prediction of the temperature at the END of the slot in progress, so it runs ahead of the measurement inside a slot; the scored comparison at slot close is in the error panels below. Dashed lines: where Omnibattery's derate begins (limit_c) and where it reaches its floor (limit_c + band_c), as read from Omnibattery.

panels.title: Omnibattery temperature sensor from Home Assistant (degC)
panels.description: hass_sensor_temperature_celsius{entity=sensor.venus_internal_temperature}: the only temperature the Venus driver exposes (inside the unit, not a cell temperature). Longer history than the service metrics. Lines at 35, 40 and 45 degC.

panels.title: Hours above 35, 40 and 45 degC (rolling 24 h)
panels.description: Hours in the last 24 h with the Home Assistant temperature sensor above each threshold (5 minute resolution): the 'hours per day above 35, 40 and 45 degC' KPI of the component page. A gap means zero hours.

panels.title: Charge derate factor: now and predicted (1 = none)
panels.description: Now: thermal_derate_factor, Omnibattery's curve at the measured temperature (absent when unknown). Predicted: thermal_predicted_derate_factor, the lowest factor predicted inside the slot in progress. Derating: 1 while the curve is in force and below 1.

panels.title: Temperature charge limit state (1 = active)
panels.description: thermal_derate_state per state: off, on or unknown. The service only reads the switch; the owner controls it.

panels.title: limit_c
panels.description: Omnibattery's temperature charge limit, degC: the derate begins above it.

panels.title: band_c
panels.description: Width of the derate band, degC: the factor falls linearly from 1 at limit_c to the floor at limit_c + band_c.

panels.title: floor_pct
panels.description: Lowest charge power as a percentage of the limit, reached at limit_c + band_c.

panels.title: limit_kw
panels.description: Charge power limit, kW, before the derate factor is applied.

panels.title: Charge power: predicted achievable and actual (kW)
panels.description: Predicted: thermal_predicted_achievable_charge_kw, the planned MEAN charge power of the slot in progress after the derate cap (0 when the slot does not charge). Actual: measured battery AC power, charging only (+ charge; discharge is drawn as 0), instantaneous and as the mean of the last 15 minutes. Ceiling now: limit_kw x derate factor, the power Omnibattery allows at the measured temperature. The scored gap over derate slots is in the achievable-charge error panel below.

panels.title: Temperature MAE per lead (degC, rolling 24 h)
panels.description: MAE = increase(thermal_temperature_abs_error_celsius_total[1d]) / increase(thermal_scored_slots_total[1d]), the mean |predicted - measured| temperature at the end of the scored slots. Lead: final = the plan of record when the slot opened; 1h and 3h = the newest plan made at least 1 h or 3 h before the slot end. Rolling 24 h, per scored slot. No line until slots have closed with a prediction (these metrics start with 0.10.0).

panels.title: Temperature RMSE per lead (degC, rolling 24 h)
panels.description: RMSE = sqrt(increase(thermal_temperature_squared_error_celsius_squared_total[1d]) / increase(thermal_scored_slots_total[1d])). Lead: final = the plan of record when the slot opened; 1h and 3h = the newest plan made at least 1 h or 3 h before the slot end. Rolling 24 h, per scored slot. No line until slots have closed with a prediction (these metrics start with 0.10.0).

panels.title: Temperature bias per lead (degC, predicted - measured, rolling 24 h)
panels.description: Mean signed error: delta(thermal_temperature_error_sum_celsius[1d]) / increase(thermal_scored_slots_total[1d]). The sum is a gauge (it falls when the model runs cold), so a restart of the service inside the window makes the day approximate. Positive: the model predicts hotter than measured. Lead: final = the plan of record when the slot opened; 1h and 3h = the newest plan made at least 1 h or 3 h before the slot end. Rolling 24 h, per scored slot. No line until slots have closed with a prediction (these metrics start with 0.10.0).

panels.title: Scored slots per lead (rolling 24 h)
panels.description: thermal_scored_slots_total: closed slots whose predicted end temperature was scored against the measurement. Up to 96 a day per lead.

panels.title: Achievable charge error in derate slots (kW, rolling 24 h)
panels.description: MAE: increase(thermal_achievable_charge_abs_error_kw_total[1d]) / increase(thermal_derate_scored_slots_total[1d]), the mean |predicted achievable - observed| mean charge power over slots with a predicted or measured derate. Bias: delta(thermal_achievable_charge_error_sum_kw[1d]) over the same count, positive when the model offers more than the battery delivered. Gauge delta: a restart inside the window makes it approximate.

panels.title: Derate-scored slots (rolling 24 h)
panels.description: thermal_derate_scored_slots_total: closed slots with a predicted or measured derate whose achievable charge was scored. Zero on a cool day.

panels.title: Parameter tau_min
panels.description: Thermal time constant, minutes. thermal_parameter{name=tau_min}. The prior until a refit is accepted; it only changes on an accepted refit.

panels.title: Parameter t_amb_c
panels.description: Equilibrium (ambient) temperature with no power, degC. thermal_parameter{name=t_amb_c}. The prior until a refit is accepted; it only changes on an accepted refit.

panels.title: Parameter k_c
panels.description: Charge gain, degC per kW of charge power. thermal_parameter{name=k_c}. The prior until a refit is accepted; it only changes on an accepted refit.

panels.title: Parameter k_d
panels.description: Discharge gain, degC per kW of discharge power; not resolved by the data yet (docs/components/battery-thermal.md). thermal_parameter{name=k_d}. The prior until a refit is accepted; it only changes on an accepted refit.

panels.title: Refits per day by result (rolling 24 h)
panels.description: thermal_refits_total{result}: the daily refit. accepted changes the parameters; rejected failed the acceptance checks; insufficient_data had too little data; error is a failure of the fit itself.

panels.title: Predictions by result (per hour)
panels.description: thermal_predictions_total{result}: one prediction per plan. error should stay at 0.

panels.title: Model status over time (1 = current)
panels.description: thermal_model_status{status}: prior, fitted or degraded.

panels.title: Observation buffer (hours with a temperature reading)
panels.description: thermal_buffer_hours: hours in the one-minute buffer; the refit needs enough of it.

panels.title: Model parameters over time
panels.description: thermal_parameter{name}: tau_min in minutes, t_amb_c in degC, k_c and k_d in degC per kW.

title: Battery: temperature
